entries.description: Bootstrap + re-ground F-1-3/F-1-2 against tree: BuildPipeline still feeds --types unvalidated into WithCategories; KnownCategories source confirmed (now includes Navigation, added by 012); SaveAsTextExporter is the lone unsanitised Path.Combine; 3 sibling exporters already sanitise; SwitchboardExporter uses fixed file names.
Authored ai-assignment.md via routed analysis (gemini-pro, cross-provider).

F-1-3: BuildPipeline validates each --types value against Pipeline.KnownCategories (union of exporter/translator/enricher categories), throws ArgumentException (exit-1 usage path) listing valid values; all-filtered-out guard via Pipeline.IsEmpty. Added KnownCategories/EnricherCategories/IsEmpty to Pipeline. Updated stale usage text (added Navigation + exit-1 note).

F-1-2: SaveAsTextExporter applies SanitizeFileName (mirrors siblings) to the object-name path component via pure PlanOutputFiles; collision guard reports a non-overwrite failure when two distinct names sanitise to the same file. Audited siblings (already sanitise) and SwitchboardExporter (fixed names).

Added hermetic pins: PipelineCategoryValidationTests (KnownCategories incl. Navigation, IsEmpty), SaveAsTextExporterSanitizeTests (PlanOutputFiles/SanitizeFileName separator + collision), CliTypesValidationTests (black-box translate exit-1 unknown/empty, exit-0 valid).

dotnet build solution green (0 errors). Hermetic: AccessHarvester.Tests new pins 22/22 pass; Integration CLI pins 7/7 (3 new + 4 usage drift). No-regen proven byte-level: CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests (COM, TRX passed=1/failed=0) reproduces the committed HHC golden — F-1-2/F-1-3 are golden-neutral. Swept spurious samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb touch.

Cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4, $0.16): VERIFIED, empty issues, substantive 4-concern prose analysis. Confirmed F-1-3 ordering/exit-code correctness, F-1-2 honest collision guard, set-specific constraints hold, factoring + pins adequate.

Bootstrap + re-ground O-1-4/F-1-5/F-1-6/O-1-7 against the tree. Confirmed the seven ParseOptions copies (Program.cs shared by 6 subcommands + 6 command classes; only GenerateMigrationCommand rejected unknown keys). F-1-5 RE-GROUNDING DELTA: found FOUR identical BuildConnectionString interpolation sites (OleDbDaoSchemaReader/OleDbValueSampler/OleDbRowSource/OleDbReportQueryExecutor), not the two the spec named (008-012 added sites). Confirmed QueryMetadataExtractor.ParseParametersClause splits on bare ',' and the clause regex terminates at first ';'; HHC's two PARAMETERS queries have no ','/';' inside brackets.

O-1-4: new shared OptionParser.Parse(args, valueOptions, flagOptions) rejects positional args, unknown --keys, and (added after R1 verification) repeated options; all seven ParseOptions copies now delegate to it with each command's exact accepted-option set preserved. O-1-7 folded in: single Commands dictionary feeds both the dispatch switch and the bare-file-mode exclusion. Pins: hermetic OptionParserTests (11 cases) + black-box CliUnknownSwitchTests (11 subcommands exit 1 + identify-cleanup exit 2).

F-1-5: new AccessHarvester.Core.Com.AceConnectionString.Build(provider, path) via OleDbConnectionStringBuilder (quotes Data Source correctly); adopted at all FOUR OLE DB sites (re-grounding expansion disclosed). Pin: hermetic AceConnectionStringTests round-trips ordinary, ';'-bearing, and quote-bearing paths.

F-1-6: bracket-aware PARAMETERS tokenisation in QueryMetadataExtractor: ExtractParametersClauseBody scans for the first depth-0 ';' (no longer truncates on a name-internal ';'); SplitTopLevel splits entries on depth-0 ',' only (no longer shreds a name-internal ','). Prefix-only regex replaces the lazy capture. Pins: comma-in-bracket -> one param; semicolon-in-bracket -> not truncated; two comma-bearing names -> two; ordinary HHC-shaped clause -> two (regression).
O-1-7: bare-file-mode exclusion and subcommand dispatch now both derive from the single Commands table (StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase), removing the hand-sync drift risk.

DW-15 recorded: identify-cleanup returns exit 2 (not the contract's 1) for usage errors by its own pre-existing inverted convention. O-1-4 only adds rejection; renumbering the exit code is out of P5 scope (and the change is exit-code-preserving for this command - it already exited 2 via the --in-required path). Pinned by IdentifyCleanup_UnknownSwitch_IsRejectedExit2.

Validation green. dotnet build solution 0 errors. Hermetic AccessHarvester.Tests 691 passed/0 failed (incl. OptionParserTests 11, AceConnectionStringTests 3, QueryMetadataExtractor F-1-6 4). Black-box Integration (CliUnknownSwitchTests + CliTypesValidationTests) 15 passed. COM tier (CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests + ManifestSchemaConformanceTests + CliExtract/Run/Translate) 10 passed -> F-1-6 GOLDEN-NEUTRAL byte-level (golden reproduced without regen). Swept spurious samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb touch; reaped one COM-wedged testhost via WMI.

Cross-provider routed session-verification (gpt-5-4). R1 ISSUES_FOUND: 1 Major - shared parser silently overwrote repeated options (--out a --out b -> last wins), still a wrong-but-successful run on malformed input. Fixed: OptionParser rejects repeated --key (value+flag, case-insensitive) + 3 new pins. R2 VERIFIED, empty issues. s2-issues.json logged.

Authored next set 014-cleanup-zero-date-guard (006 P6: zero-date misfire + O-1-5 + O-2-6) via routed recommendation (gpt-5-4 planning): spec.md + v4 not-started session-state.json stub + next-session-set-recommendation.md (Hard Constraints carried verbatim). Recommended Opus 4.8 @ low, P0-only, 1 session - closes the 006 review arc.

Closeout: disposition.json, change-log.md, set-wide devil's-advocate prompt (set013-devils-advocate-prompt.md, for human-driven GPT+Gemini), activity-log backfill; commit+push; close_session; notify; Step 9 reorg review.
